items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: they needed a pianist in the orchestra, because there was a piano player from Columbus, Ohio by the name of Al Freeman... So they were trying to locate, trying to find a piano player... 'Nellie plays well enough to play with us.'

ctx.x: And he wouldn't have been any relation to the Al Freeman, Jr. who's an actor?
I think that's his father. Al Freeman, Jr. is this Al Freeman's son.
I wondered if it might be. I mean Al Freeman is not a terribly unusual name.
